name: Untitled
line: One line about the map, for the picker's card.
notes: Copy this file to <id>.json, edit it, then run tools/level.sh check <id> until it is quiet and tools/level.sh render <id> to look at it. Positions are fractions of the field (0..1 across, 0..1 down); sizes are fractions of its shorter side. There are rules docs/levels.md lists: everything inside the field, routes through gaps at least 1.6 marbles wide (aim for 2.5), starts and coin zones clear of walls and hazards, four bumper starts 3 marbles apart, and no free spot a marble can never reach.
